John Lambie (engineer) John Lambie was a Scottish engineer.
He was born in Saltcoats, Ayrshire, in 1833 and died in Glasgow on 1 February 1895.
He was Locomotive Superintendent of the Caledonian Railway from 1891 to 1895.
